name: UI：任务管理-分配明细数据行内容验证
description: 验证分配明细表格数据行：审核人(多人)/状态/进度/时长/通过率

steps.expression: (() => { const modal = document.querySelector('.ant-modal:not(.ant-modal-hidden)'); if(!modal) return { hasModal: false }; const rows = modal.querySelectorAll('.ant-table-row'); const firstRow = rows[0]; if(!firstRow) return { hasModal: true, rowCount: 0 }; const cells = Array.from(firstRow.querySelectorAll('td')).map(td => td.textContent.trim()); const btns = Array.from(firstRow.querySelectorAll('button')).map(b => b.textContent.trim()); return { hasModal: true, rowCount: rows.length, cells, btns }; })()

_testDesign.preconditions: F88预发已登录；存在任务管理数据
_testDesign.realDomNotes: 审核人可能多人(逗号分隔)，操作列有'转交'按钮
